title: Kamishiro Rui — Talking At Dusk〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: After the closing ceremony
Diner

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, everyone! Do you have your glasses?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Tsukasa, could you please use your indoor voice?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ahaha... We sure are getting a lot of looks from other tables.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmph. That was supposed to be my indoor voice... It seems people can't help but be drawn in by my voice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Perhaps your enunciation is so well trained that your voice carries without you thinking about it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ahaha! Whaddya expect from a professional actor?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's no need to praise me so much. Even still, I don't want to be a bother to other customers. Could someone take my place?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How about Rui? He's in the same year as you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I suppose I could. Though, I'd hate to steal the limelight when you three are the ones who made it through the supplementary classes...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No no no, that doesn't matter! Go on, Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh well. It's hard to say no to my junior.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Everyone, well done on making it through a tough week. Although it's somewhat belated, let's enjoy this little after-party!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: On that note, cheers!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akiyama, would you mind sharing some of your French fries with us?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sure thing! Grab me some serving plates!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you! We appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, what...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Kamishiro... You've been really focused for a while now. What's up?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I'm removing the vegetables from this pizza.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, do you not eat vegetables?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, I do not. It is beyond my comprehension what anyone sees in these things.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Guess that hasn't changed. Wanna trade your broccoli for my salami?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I would be happy to. Thank you, Mizuki. Don't mind if I do...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, I heard from Mizuki that you three might have to leave partway through. Are you still okay for time?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that's okay! My dad canceled practice for today and told us to spend time with our friends!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He said, “They stayed back after school for a whole week for you, so go hang out with them.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, I'm glad.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm going to get a drink. Where's the juice bar?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, I saw it by the entrance.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Safe travels♪
I recommend a melon soda and cola mocktail! It's one part—

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, don't go giving him weird ideas.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll go with you, Aoyagi. I'd like to get a soup refill.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, let's go together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, by the way. I wanted to say something to you, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To me? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wanted to thank you again.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Both the study session and this after-party have been very fun. Also...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Here you go!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: An, I'm rooting for you to make it into second year armed with this!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you, Mizuki! I'll make good use of it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've seen new sides to everyone, and it's been a very good experience.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I want to thank you for coming to me about the supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's me who should be thanking you, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's thanks to you and Mizuki that Akito and Shiraishi are going to join me in second year.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I'm truly grateful.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not to mention... This has all made for a memorable end to my first year, too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Then I'm glad. That makes two of us coming out of this having made some memories.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, it looks like we're missing out on the fun over there.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It does indeed. Why don't we go back and join them?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, let's.
